name: The Heretical Petition: Confessor Malachi Petitions the Silent King

cycle_advancement.world_state: The Silent King's Gambits: Malachi Proclaims Necron Resurrection Quest

locations_modified.ambient_tension: Beneath the cyclopean pre-Imperial towers at (0,0), a hidden subterranean vault of green-veined Noctilith (Blackstone) has begun to hum. Emerald scarab glyphs glow in mathematical synchronicity, emitting a quantum-tachyon signal into the cold dark of intergalactic space: an open channel to the Triarch and Szarekh, the Silent King.

The Basilica stands under intense, electrified silence. Captain Severus and his Terminator Honor Guard keep their storm bolters magnetized to their cuirasses, watchful eyes locked onto Confessor Malachi. Holy incense mixes with the ozone stench of xenos chronomancy.

completed_milestones.title: Confessor Malachi Proclaims the Silent King Bargain to Captain Severus
completed_milestones.consequence: Confessor Malachi broke absolute ecclesiarchal dogma, announcing to Captain Severus of the Ultramarines his intent to petition Szarekh, the Silent King, for Necron reanimation and soul-tethering technology to resurrect Sergeant Vane, Bragg, Jax, and Kroll, knowingly risking his own mortal life and soul.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Triarch Communion & The Biotransference Gamble
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: The Blackstone Transponder at (0,0) requires bio-neural resonance. Opening the channel to the Silent King will violently siphon mortal vitality and sanity, and an emissary of the Necron Dynasties (Chronomancer or Triarch Praetorian) may extract a terrifying price.
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Confessor Malachi must descend to the Sunken Necropolis, interface his mortal mind with the Blackstone glyphs, and endure the lethal neural feedback to state his petition to the Silent King.

new_decision.decision: Approached Captain Severus in the Basilica and solemnly announced the ultimate gamble: to reach out across the void to Szarekh, the Silent King of the Necrons, using the Sunken Necropolis's ancient Blackstone array to petition for resurrection protocols to bring back Vane, Bragg, Jax, and Kroll, pledging his own life as collateral.
new_decision.impact: Stunned the Ultramarines; established high-stakes truce under Guilliman's pragmatic precedent; opened active trial 'The Triarch Communion'.

new_decision.decision: Listened to Confessor Malachi's plea; cited the Primarch's secret diplomatic precedents with the Silent King during the Pariah Nexus, and granted conditional permission for Malachi to probe the Blackstone transponder, warning that any betrayal or soulless monstrosity will be answered with immediate exterminatus.
new_decision.impact: Kept the strike force on high alert; detached the Kastelan Automaton to escort Malachi to the Sunken Necropolis.
